Materials are used to make potions. The materials will pass through the top of the screen. They are constantly created and do not cost any money. If the material put into the empty cauldron, the corresponding potion will be made. Add more materials afterwards will raise the potion's price. The better materials can be get by upgrade materials, and more advanced materials means a higher selling price. There is no upper limit to increasing the potion's price with materials.[1]
